title: Utility Pass-Through Service Decision Table — Household History as the Basis of an Estimated Water Read
content:
**Rule.** For an estimated water read on a Utility Pass-Through Service account, the household's history decides which actual reads the estimate starts from. Where the account has an actual water read taken twelve whole months before the handling date and the Home-Site Lease the account serves has had no occupant registration accepted in the last twelve months, the read cycle a year earlier stands in for the household's use, and the consumption of that one read replaces the four-month average. Where the Home-Site Lease the account serves has had an occupant registration accepted in the last twelve months and the account has at least one actual water read taken in the last three months, only the household's current make-up counts, and the average consumption of the actual water reads taken in the last three months replaces the four-month average. On any other account the four-month average is not replaced.

## Definitions

- **Taken twelve whole months before the handling date**: an actual water read whose read date is separated from the handling date by exactly 12 whole months (12 whole months, but not 13). Should more than one actual water read fall there, the average of their consumption is used.
- **In the last N months**: fewer than N whole months separate the date from the handling date — fewer than 3 whole months for the three-month reads, fewer than 12 whole months for occupant registrations.
- **Occupant registration accepted**: an occupant registration request on the Home-Site Lease with the status accepted, dated by the effective date the registration names.
- **Actual water read**: a water read of the type "actual".

## Decision table

| Actual water read exactly 12 whole months back | Occupant registration accepted on the Home-Site Lease in the last 12 months | Actual water read in the last 3 months | Reads the estimate starts from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Yes or no | That year-earlier read alone |
| Yes or no | Yes | Yes | Average of the actual water reads of the last 3 months |
| Yes or no | Yes | No | The four-month average, not replaced |
| No | No | Yes or no | The four-month average, not replaced |

## Dates worked (handling date 10 June, hypothetical)

| Actual water read dated | Whole months to 10 June | Exactly 12 whole months back? | In the last 3 months? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 22 May of the previous year | 12 | Yes | No |
| 10 June of the previous year | 12 | Yes | No |
| 22 June of the previous year | 11 | No | No |
| 22 April of the previous year | 13 | No | No |
| 22 March of this year | 2 | No | Yes |
| 10 March of this year | 3 | No | No |

**Example (hypothetical).** An account whose lease shows no accepted occupant registration in the last 12 months has an actual water read of 5.30 kgal dated 22 May of the previous year: the estimate starts from 5.30 kgal. Had the lease accepted an occupant registration effective 1 February, and the account had actual reads of 3.60 and 4.00 kgal in the last 3 months, the estimate would start from their average, 3.80 kgal.
